title: Stop the list from blanking on every fetch
acceptanceCriteria: The first load shows a loading state (not *No todos*), then the list
A background refetch (**Refresh**) keeps the list on screen and shows *Refreshing…*
A failed refetch keeps the list on screen and adds an error banner
A failed first load shows the error instead of a list
**Next** keeps the current page on screen until the next page arrives, and is disabled meanwhile
*No todos* appears only once an empty list has loaded
